profile.title: Profile
profile.sessionNote: Sessions belong to one node: switching node asks you to sign in again.

password.title: Password
password.policy: At least 12 characters from three of: lowercase, uppercase, digits, symbols
password.mustChange: An administrator asks you to choose a new password.

errors.passwordClasses: Use three of: lowercase, uppercase, digits, symbols
errors.same: Choose a password different from the current one

totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.help: A 6-digit code from an authenticator app at each sign-in.
totp.step1: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, or type the secret.
totp.step2: Enter the 6-digit code it shows to confirm.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app

errors.code: Enter the 6 digits shown by the app

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.help: Saved to your account and applied on every node.
preferences.animationsHelp: Reduced keeps short fades and stops looping effects. Your system's reduced motion setting always applies.
preferences.ambientHelp: Ambient backgrounds are a faint graticule and live traces under the data. They stand still unless animations are full.
